verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at https://docs.highnote.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary header. The agentic-commerce page is also served as a .md file (highnote.com/solutions/agentic-commerce.md), suggesting markdown versions of pages are available for agents. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt coverage depth (e.g., llms-full.txt or links to every doc page), confirmed markdown versions of the docs pages themselves, and independent corroboration of agents using these docs successfully.
